eventMetadata.context_description: Recent forecasts from PAGASA and global models indicate Manila highs of 33–35°C on May 19, driven by typical late-dry-season conditions of strong solar heating, light winds, and high humidity that support afternoon peaks near the historical May average of 34°C.
